puzzle.text: Solve the lever puzzle (the doors open by the levers): 1) Pull levers A and B down. 2) Go north into the room with levers C and D and pull D down. 3) Go west, then south, back to the first room, and pull A and B up. 4) Go north, west, then north into the room with levers E and F and pull both down. 5) Go east, then east again into the room with C and D, and pull C down. 6) Go west twice back to E and F and pull E up. 7) Go east, south, south, then west through the door to the oil can, and pick it up.

wydin.text: Back in Port Sarim, wear a white apron and ask Wydin for a job, then search the crate in the back room of his store.
options: Can I get a job here?

crate.text: Search the crate in the back of Wydin's store for your rum.

frank.text: Give the rum to Redbeard Frank.

chest.text: Use the key on the chest upstairs in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock, then read the message.

dig.text: Dig with a spade in the flower bed in Falador park; the gardener attacks, then dig again.

rewards: One-Eyed Hector's treasure: 450 coins, a gold ring and an emerald

imp.name: Imp Catcher
imp.start: Talk to Wizard Mizgog at the top of the Wizards' Tower.

goUp.text: Climb the staircase in the Wizards' Tower.

goUp2.text: Climb up the staircase again to the top floor.
options: Climb up

start.text: Talk to Wizard Mizgog to start the quest.
options: Give me a quest please.

beads.text: Collect one of each bead. Imps drop them; they are all over the land.

finish.text: Bring the four beads to Wizard Mizgog.

junglepotion.name: Jungle Potion
junglepotion.start: Talk to Trufitus in Tai Bwo Wannai, Karamja.
skills: 3 Herblore
Druidic Ritual

start.text: Talk to Trufitus in Tai Bwo Wannai, Karamja.
options: It's a nice village, where is everyone?
Me? How can I help?
It sounds like just the challenge for me.

pickSnake.text: Search the vine by the river south-west of the village for snake weed.

giveSnake.text: Clean the snake weed and use it on Trufitus.

pickArdrigal.text: Search the palm trees north-east of the village for ardrigal.

giveArdrigal.text: Clean the ardrigal and use it on Trufitus.

pickSito.text: Search the scorched earth west of the village for sito foil.

giveSito.text: Clean the sito foil and use it on Trufitus.

pickMoss.text: Search the rocks south-east of the village for volencia moss.

giveMoss.text: Clean the volencia moss and use it on Trufitus.

cave.text: Climb down the pothole north of the village ("Yes, I'll enter the cave.").
options: Yes, I'll enter the cave.

pickPurse.text: Search the cave wall for rogue's purse.

givePurse.text: Clean the rogue's purse and use it on Trufitus.

finish.text: Talk to Trufitus to finish.

priest.name: The Restless Ghost
priest.start: Talk to Father Aereck in the church in Lumbridge.

amulet.name: Amulet of ghostspeak
amulet.tip: Father Urhney gives you another if you lose it

aereck.text: Talk to Father Aereck in the Lumbridge church.
options: I'm looking for a quest!
Ok, let me help then.

urhney.text: Talk to Father Urhney in his hut in Lumbridge Swamp.
options: Father Aereck sent me to talk to you.
He's got a ghost haunting his graveyard.

coffin.text: Wear the amulet of ghostspeak and open the coffin in the graveyard to make the ghost appear.

ghost.text: Talk to the ghost while wearing the amulet of ghostspeak.
options: Yep, now tell me what the problem is.
Yes, ok. Do you know why you're a ghost?

tower.text: Climb down the ladder into the Wizards' Tower basement, south of Draynor.

skull.text: Pick up the ghost's skull in the far corner of the basement. A skeleton appears and attacks: you can just run.

openCoffin.text: Open the coffin in the Lumbridge graveyard.

putSkull.text: Use the skull on the open coffin to finish the quest.

priestperil.name: Priest in Peril
priestperil.start: Talk to King Roald in Varrock Palace.

bucket.name: Bucket
bucket.tip: For water from the well in the mausoleum

goldkey.name: Golden key
goldkey.tip: The monks in the temple drop it

ironkey.name: Iron key
ironkey.tip: Swap the golden key for it at the right monument

essence.name: Rune or pure essence
essence.tip: Unnoted; mine it at the Rune Essence mine

skills: Able to defeat a level 30 temple guardian and level 30 monks

start.text: Talk to King Roald in Varrock Palace.
options: I'm looking for a quest!
Sure.

doors.text: Knock at the doors of the temple of Paterdomus, east of Varrock over the river.
options: Roald sent me to check on Drezel.
Sure.

dog.text: Go down the trapdoor north of the temple and kill the temple guardian.

drezel.text: Go into the temple, up to the top floor, and talk to Drezel through the cell door.
options: Tell me anyway.
Yes.

monks.text: Kill the monks in the temple for the golden key.

monument.text: In the mausoleum, study the monuments and use the golden key on the one holding the iron key.

well.text: Use a bucket on the well in the mausoleum for murky water.

unlock.text: Use the iron key on Drezel's cell door.

bless.text: Talk to Drezel with the murky water so he blesses it.

coffin.text: Use the blessed water on the coffin.

mausoleum.text: Meet Drezel in the mausoleum, past the gates at its east end.

essence.text: Bring Drezel 50 rune essence (or pure essence); use them on him.

prince.name: Prince Ali Rescue
prince.start: Talk to Hassan in the Al Kharid palace.

clay.name: Clay
clay.tip: Mine it in the mine south-west of Varrock

water.name: Bucket or jug of water
water.tip: Fill a bucket or jug at a well, fountain or sink; Hassan also hands you a jug of water if you tell him it is too hot

softclay.name: Soft clay
softclay.tip: Use clay on a bucket or jug of water

bronze.name: Bronze bar
bronze.tip: Smelt a copper ore and a tin ore at a furnace (Lumbridge has one), or buy one from Shantay

key.name: Key to the prince's door
key.tip: Leela gives it once Osman has had it made

wool.name: Ball of wool
wool.tip: Shear sheep and spin the wool on a spinning wheel (Lumbridge Castle, first floor)

plainwig.name: Wig
plainwig.tip: Ned makes it from 3 balls of wool

onion.name: Onion
onion.tip: Pick them in the field north of Rimmington

yellowdye.name: Yellow dye
yellowdye.tip: Aggie makes it from 2 onions and 5 coins

redberries.name: Redberries
redberries.tip: Picked up south-east of Varrock, or bought from Wydin in Port Sarim

flour.name: Pot of flour
flour.tip: Grind wheat at the mill north of Lumbridge

ashes.name: Ashes
ashes.tip: Left behind when a fire burns out

paste.name: Paste
paste.tip: Aggie mixes it from ashes, flour, water and redberries

rope.name: Rope
rope.tip: Ned sells it for 15 coins (or makes it from 4 balls of wool)

beer.name: Beer
beer.tip: The bartender in the Rusty Anchor, Port Sarim, or the Blue Moon Inn, Varrock, sells it

coins.name: Coins
coins.tip: 5 for the dye and 15 for the rope

on: osman takes the key imprint and the bronze bar

start.text: Talk to Hassan in the Al Kharid palace.
options: Can I help you? You must need some help here in the desert.

osman.text: Talk to Osman, just north of the palace.
options: What is the first thing I must do?
Okay, I better go find some things.

clay.text: Mine some clay in the mine south-west of Varrock.

softclay.text: Use the clay on a bucket or jug of water to make soft clay.

keli.text: Talk to Lady Keli in the jail east of Draynor Village and take an imprint of her key.
options: Heard of you? You are famous in RuneScape!
What is your latest plan then?
Can you be sure they will not try to get him out?
Could I see the key please?
Could I touch the key for a moment?

bronze.text: Get a bronze bar: smelt a copper ore and a tin ore at the furnace in Lumbridge.

osmanKey.text: Bring the key print and the bronze bar to Osman.

leelaKey.text: Talk to Leela, east of Draynor Village, to collect the key.

wool.text: Get 3 balls of wool: shear sheep and spin the wool on a spinning wheel.

nedWig.text: Talk to Ned in Draynor Village and ask him to make a wig.
options: Ned, could you make other things from wool?
How about some sort of wig?
I have that now. Please, make me a wig.

onions.text: Pick 2 onions in the field north of Rimmington.

yellowDye.text: Talk to Aggie in Draynor Village and ask for yellow dye (2 onions and 5 coins).
options: Can you make dyes for me please?
What do you need to make yellow dye?
Okay, make me some yellow dye please.

dyeWig.text: Use the yellow dye on the wig.

skirt.text: Buy a pink skirt from Thessalia in Varrock.

redberries.text: Pick up some redberries south-east of Varrock.

flour.text: Get a pot of flour: put grain in the hopper at the mill north of Lumbridge, pull the lever and use a pot on the flour bin.

ashes.text: Light a fire with logs and a tinderbox, and pick up the ashes when it burns out.

getWater.text: Fill a bucket or jug with water at a well.

paste.text: Talk to Aggie and ask her to make skin paste.
options: Could you think of a way to make skin paste?
Yes please. Mix me some skin paste.

rope.text: Buy a rope from Ned in Draynor Village for 15 coins.
options: Yes, I would like some rope.
Okay, please sell me some rope.

leela.text: Bring the key, wig, skirt and paste to Leela.

beer.text: Buy 3 beers, from the bartender in the Rusty Anchor in Port Sarim.
options: Could I buy a beer please?

joe.text: Talk to Joe, the guard at the jail door, and give him the beers.
options: I have some beer here, fancy one?

tieKeli.text: Use the rope on Lady Keli.

door.text: Use the key on the prince's cell door.

prince.text: Talk to Prince Ali and give him the disguise and the key.

finish.text: Return to Hassan in the Al Kharid palace for your reward.

rewards: Free use of the Al Kharid toll gate

romeojuliet.name: Romeo & Juliet
romeojuliet.start: Talk to Romeo in Varrock Square.

message.name: Message
message.tip: Juliet gives you another if you lose it

berries.name: Cadava berries
berries.tip: From the bushes south-east of Varrock

romeo.text: Talk to Romeo in Varrock Square.
options: Can I help find her for you?

goUp.text: Climb the stairs in Juliet's house, west of Varrock.

juliet.text: Talk to Juliet upstairs in her house west of Varrock.

message.text: Bring Juliet's message to Romeo in Varrock Square.

lawrence.text: Talk to Father Lawrence in the church in north-east Varrock.

berries.text: Pick up some cadava berries by the bushes south-east of Varrock.

apothecary.text: Bring the cadava berries to the Apothecary in south-west Varrock.

goUp2.text: Bring the potion to Juliet: climb the stairs in her house.

potion.text: Give the cadava potion to Juliet.

finish.text: Talk to Romeo in Varrock Square to finish the quest.

runemysteries.name: Rune Mysteries Quest
runemysteries.start: Talk to Duke Horacio on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle.

talisman.name: Air talisman
talisman.tip: Duke Horacio gives you another if you lose it

package.name: Research package
package.tip: Sedridor gives you another if you lose it

notes.name: Research notes
notes.tip: Aubury gives you another if you lose them

goUp.text: Climb the staircase in Lumbridge Castle to the first floor.

duke.text: Talk to Duke Horacio on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle.
options: Have you any quests for me?
Sure, no problem.
Climb down the stairs.

tower.text: Climb down the ladder into the Wizards' Tower basement, south of Draynor.

giveTalisman.text: Give the air talisman to Sedridor, the head wizard, in the basement.
options: I'm looking for the head wizard.
Ok, here you are.

getPackage.text: Talk to Sedridor again and agree to take his research package to Aubury.
options: Yes, certainly.

aubury.text: Bring the research package to Aubury in his rune shop in south-east Varrock.

auburyAgain.text: Talk to Aubury again for his research notes.

giveNotes.text: Bring the research notes to Sedridor in the Wizards' Tower basement.

rewards: Access to the Rune Essence mine

scorpcatcher.name: Scorpion Catcher
scorpcatcher.start: Talk to Thormac at the top of the Sorcerer's Tower south of Seers' Village.

cage.name: Scorpion cage
cage.tip: Thormac gives it (and another if you lose it)

gotB.name: Cage with the Barbarian Outpost scorpion

skills: Able to get past the monsters in Taverley Dungeon

start.text: Talk to Thormac at the top of the Sorcerer's Tower.
options: What do you need assistance with?
So how would I go about catching them then?
Ok, I will do it then.

seer.text: Talk to the Seer in Seers' Village.
options: I need to locate some scorpions.

scorpA.text: Go into Taverley Dungeon, through the secret wall, and use the cage on the scorpion.

seer2.text: Talk to the Seer again for where the next scorpion is.

scorpC.text: Use the cage on the scorpion upstairs in the Monastery south of Edgeville.

peksa.text: Ask Peksa in Barbarian Village about his scorpion.
options: I've heard you have a small scorpion in your possession.

scorpB.text: Use the cage on the scorpion at the Barbarian Outpost.

finish.text: Bring the full cage to Thormac.

sheep.name: Sheep Shearer
sheep.start: Talk to Fred the Farmer north-west of Lumbridge.

shears.name: Shears
shears.tip: There is a pair in Fred's house

start.text: Talk to Fred the Farmer north-west of Lumbridge to start the quest.
options: I'm looking for a quest.
Yes okay. I can do that.
Yes, okay. I can do that.

getShears.text: Pick up the shears in Fred's house.

shear.text: Shear the sheep in the field next to Fred until you have enough wool.

goUp.text: Climb the staircase in Lumbridge Castle to the spinning wheel.

spin.text: Spin your wool into balls of wool on the spinning wheel.

options: Climb down the stairs.

handIn.text: Bring Fred your balls of wool. You can hand in some at a time.

sheepherder.name: Sheep Herder
sheepherder.start: Talk to Councillor Halgrive in East Ardougne.

feed.name: Poisoned sheep feed
feed.tip: Councillor Halgrive gives it (and more if you lose it)

jacket.name: Protective jacket
jacket.tip: Doctor Orbon sells the outfit for 100 coins

prod.name: Cattleprod
prod.tip: Lies in the sheep pen by Farmer Brumty

start.text: Talk to Councillor Halgrive in Ardougne.
options: What's wrong?
I can do that for you.

orbon.text: Buy protective clothing from Doctor Orbon, next to the councillor.
options: Ok, I'll take it.

prod.text: Wear the protective clothing, go into the pen north of Ardougne by Farmer Brumty and pick up the cattleprod.

sheep.text: Wield the cattleprod and prod each of the four diseased sheep (around the farms north of Ardougne) into the pen, then use the poisoned feed on each one there. When all four are burnt, talk to Councillor Halgrive.

burn.text: Put the sheep bones in the furnace by the pen.

finish.text: Once all four sheep are burnt, return to Councillor Halgrive.

squire.name: The Knight's Sword
squire.start: Talk to the Squire in the courtyard of Falador castle.

pie.name: Redberry pie
pie.tip: Use redberries on a pie shell and bake it on a range (10 Cooking)

blurite.name: Blurite ore
blurite.tip: Mine it in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon south of Port Sarim (10 Mining)

iron.name: Iron bar
iron.tip: Smelt iron ore at a furnace (15 Smithing)

skills: 10 Mining

start.text: Talk to the Squire in the courtyard of Falador castle.
options: And how is life as a squire?
Is he angry?
Well, the kingdom is fairly abundant with swords...
So would these dwarves make another one?
Ok, I'll give it a go.

reldo.text: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Palace library.
options: What do you know about the Imcando dwarves?

pie.text: Bring a redberry pie to Thurgo on the cliffs south of Port Sarim.
options: Would you like a redberry pie?

thurgo.text: Talk to Thurgo again and ask him to make the sword.

cupboard.text: Search Sir Vyvin's cupboard on the top floor of Falador castle for the portrait, while Sir Vyvin is not near it.

blurite.text: Mine a blurite ore in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon (in the cave south of Port Sarim). Ice warriors and giants guard it.

sword.text: Bring the blurite ore and 2 iron bars to Thurgo.

finish.text: Bring the sword to the Squire.

totem.name: Tribal Totem
totem.start: Talk to Kangai Mau in the food store in Brimhaven.

label.name: Address label
label.tip: Peeled off a crate in the RPDT depot in Ardougne

skills: 21 Thieving

start.text: Talk to Kangai Mau in the food store in Brimhaven.
options: I'm in search of adventure!
Tell me of this mission.
Ok, I will get it back.

label.text: Investigate the crate in the RPDT depot in Ardougne and take its label.

crate.text: Use the label on the other crate in the depot.

employee.text: Talk to the RPDT employee and ask about the delivery.
options: So, when are you going to deliver this crate?

cromperty.text: Talk to Wizard Cromperty in north-east Ardougne and have him teleport you.
options: So what have you invented?
Can I be teleported please?
Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!

door.text: Open the door with the combination K U R T.

stairs.text: Search the stairs for traps (21 Thieving) to note the trap, then climb them.

chest.text: Open the chest upstairs and take the totem.

finish.text: Bring the totem to Kangai Mau in Brimhaven.

tree.name: Tree Gnome Village
tree.start: Talk to King Bolren in the middle of the Tree Gnome Village maze.
skills: Able to defeat a level 112 Khazard warlord (he can be safespotted)

start.text: Talk to King Bolren in the middle of the maze. Elkoy at the maze entrance can show you through.
options: Can I help at all?
I would be glad to help.

montai.text: Talk to Commander Montai at the battlefield north of the maze.
options: Ok, I'll gather some wood.
I'll try my best.

tracker1.text: Talk to the tracker gnome by the stronghold for the height coordinate (4).

tracker2.text: Talk to the captured tracker gnome through the bars of his cell for the y coordinate (5).

tracker3.text: The third tracker gnome answers in riddles; the x coordinate is 3.

ballista.text: Fire the ballista: height 0004, x 0003, y 0005.

wall.text: Climb over the crumbled wall of the Khazard stronghold. The Khazard commander attacks.

chest.text: Go upstairs and search the open chest for the orb of protection.

bolren.text: Bring the orb to King Bolren.
options: I will find the warlord and bring back the orbs.

warlord.text: Kill the Khazard warlord north-west of the battlefield; you take the orbs from his satchel.

finish.text: Bring the orbs to King Bolren.

vampire.name: Vampire Slayer
vampire.start: Talk to Morgan in his house in Draynor Village.

beer.name: Beer
beer.tip: The bartender in the Blue Moon Inn sells it

stake.name: Stake
stake.tip: Dr Harlow gives it once you buy him a beer

garlic.name: Garlic
garlic.tip: In the cupboard upstairs in Morgan's house

skills: Able to defeat Count Draynor (level 34)

start.text: Talk to Morgan in his house in Draynor Village.
options: Ok, I'm up for an adventure.

garlic.text: Search the cupboard upstairs in Morgan's house for garlic (it weakens the Count).

harlow.text: Talk to Dr Harlow in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock and buy him a beer for a stake.
options: Morgan needs your help

count.text: Go down to the basement of Draynor Manor, open the coffin and kill Count Draynor. Keep the stake and hammer with you to finish him.

waterfall.name: Waterfall Quest
waterfall.start: Talk to Almera in her house by the Baxtorian Falls, north of the Fishing Guild.

rope.name: Rope
rope.tip: Sold by general stores such as Arhein's in Catherby

book.name: Book on Baxtorian
book.tip: In the bookcase upstairs in Hadley's house

amulet.name: Glarial's amulet
amulet.tip: In the chest in Glarial's tomb

urn.name: Glarial's urn
urn.tip: In the coffin in Glarial's tomb

bkey.name: Key (Baxtorian's doors)
bkey.tip: In a crate inside the waterfall

skills: Able to survive a few level 30-ish monsters

start.text: Talk to Almera in her house by the Baxtorian Falls.
options: How can I help?

raft.text: Board the log raft behind the house; it crashes on the island where Hudon is.

bookcase.text: Go to Hadley's house south of the falls, climb upstairs and search the bookcase for the Book on Baxtorian.

ladderGnome.text: Go to the Tree Gnome Village and climb down the ladder in its north-east.

crate.text: Search the crate in the east of the cave for a key. Watch out for the hobgoblins.

gate.text: Use the key on Golrie's gate and talk to Golrie; take Glarial's pebble from his junk.

tombstone.text: Bank every weapon, piece of armour and rune (nothing of those may be carried in), then use Glarial's pebble on her tombstone east of Hadley's house.

chest.text: Search the chest in the tomb for Glarial's amulet.

coffin.text: Search Glarial's coffin for her urn.

runes.text: Get 6 air, 6 earth and 6 water runes (and a rope) from the bank, and come back to Almera's house.

raftAgain.text: Board the log raft behind Almera's house again, wearing Glarial's amulet.

rock.text: Use the rope on the rock south of the island.

tree.text: Use the rope on the dead tree to lower yourself onto the ledge.

ledgeDoor.text: Open the door on the ledge, with Glarial's amulet on.

bkey.text: Search the crate in the east room for a key.

door.text: Use the key on the doors to the north-west to reach the room with the pillars.

pillars.text: Use an air, an earth and a water rune on each of the six pillars, then use Glarial's amulet on the statue.

chalice.text: Use Glarial's urn on the chalice to take the treasure. You need 5 free inventory spaces.
